biggest_catch: TestingTime is Europe-focused (strongest in Switzerland, Germany, France, Austria, UK, Netherlands) — testers elsewhere get far fewer invites, and invites are irregular and first-come-first-served.
catches: Most studies run in continental Europe; US testers see far fewer opportunities.
Invitations are irregular and awarded first-come, first-served — you may go weeks with nothing.
You see the exact compensation in each invitation before accepting; lower-paying surveys exist alongside €40+ studies.
Some countries have a €21 payout threshold before withdrawal.
Bank-transfer payouts may carry bank fees depending on country; PayPal payouts have fees covered by TestingTime.
You must be reliable and punctual — clients rely on scheduled live sessions (in-person, Skype/Zoom).

steps: Sign up at testingtime.com (takes ~3 minutes) with your profile.
Receive email invitations for studies matching your profile; each shows the exact compensation.
Accept on a first-come, first-served basis and pick a time slot.
Complete the guided usability test (remote via Skype/Zoom or in-person), typically 30-90 minutes.
Provide your PayPal or bank details after your first test; receive payment within 10 business days.
timing: Paid via PayPal or bank transfer within 10 business days of the completed study (official FAQ).

repeatable.cadence: invitations arrive by email whenever a study matches your profile — irregular and first-come-first-served — and you can accept each one you qualify for

maximize: Official FAQ: paid via PayPal or bank transfer within 10 business days of the completed study. Fastest path: none — fixed 10-business-day window. Blocker: official window.
who_pays: TestingTime pays you directly. You see the exact compensation in each invitation before you accept, then get paid via PayPal or bank transfer.
who_qualifies: No experience needed — sign up with your profile for matching. Typical studies run 30–90 minutes via Skype/Zoom or in person, and you must be reliable and punctual since clients rely on scheduled live sessions. Availability is strongest in Switzerland, Germany, France, Austria, the UK and the Netherlands.
work_available: Irregular and first-come-first-served: invitations depend on your profile and study demand, and you can go weeks with nothing. Europe (CH, DE, FR, AT, UK, NL) gets the most; testers elsewhere see far fewer invites.
what_gets_accepted: Show up at the agreed time and successfully complete the guided usability test — only then are you entitled to your compensation. Reliability and punctuality are required; clients are relying on you.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join with no fees. Unpaid time: building your profile and waiting between irregular invites. PayPal payouts have fees covered by TestingTime, but bank transfers may carry bank fees depending on your country; some countries also have a €21 payout threshold.
when_cash_arrives: Via PayPal or bank transfer within 10 business days of the completed study.
